items.title: General Electric (GE) Updates Engine Checks After Study Flags Early Blade Cracks
items.summary: General Electric (NYSE:GE) unit GE Aerospace updated GEnx-1B inspection guidance after a new China-based study flagged premature blade cracks. The research focused on GEnx-1B engines installed on Boeing 787 Dreamliners and highlighted cracking in certain turbine blades under service conditions. Revised maintenance guidance is expected to affect inspection intervals for affected GEnx-1B engines operated by airlines using 787 fleets.
